cards.front: What is a key idea from 'Shapes and Patterns'?
cards.back: If you look closely, you will notice different weaving patterns on each basket.

cards.front: What is a key idea from 'Shapes and Patterns'?
cards.back: We will try weaving some mats with paper strips.

cards.front: What is a key idea from 'Shapes and Patterns'?
cards.back: You will need — A coloured paper (30 cm long and 20 cm wide) and eight paper strips of two different colours (3 cm wide and longer than 20 cm).

cards.front: What is a key idea from 'Shapes and Patterns'?
cards.back: (a) Take a coloured paper 30 cm long and 20 cm wide.

cards.front: What is a key idea from 'Shapes and Patterns'?
cards.back: (b) Fold the coloured paper in half along the longer side.
